hook.en: A speedometer does not show your average for the trip. It shows how fast you are going right now.
hook.kn: ಸ್ಪೀಡೋಮೀಟರ್ ಪ್ರಯಾಣದ ಸರಾಸರಿಯನ್ನು ತೋರಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಈ ಕ್ಷಣದ ವೇಗವನ್ನು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: Instantaneous *velocity* is the limit of average velocity as the time interval shrinks to zero: $v = dx/dt$. On an x–t graph it is the slope of the tangent at that instant. Instantaneous speed is the magnitude of instantaneous velocity.
body.kn: ತಾತ್ಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ವೇಗ ಎಂದರೆ ಕಾಲದ ಅಂತರ ಶೂನ್ಯದತ್ತ ಸಾಗುವಾಗ ಸರಾಸರಿ ವೇಗದ ಮಿತಿ: v = dx/dt.

say.en: Slope of the tangent to the x-t graph.
Here is the x–t curve of a body with x equal to t squared by two.
Chords from P give average velocities. As the second point moves closer to P, the chords tilt towards one line.
In the limit the chord becomes the tangent. Its slope is the instantaneous velocity, dx by dt.
Differentiate: x equals t squared by two gives v equals t. At two seconds the velocity is two metres per second, the slope of the tangent.

narration.en: The orange chord joins the positions at t and t + Δt; its slope is the average velocity over Δt. Shrink Δt and the chord turns into the tangent: its slope is the instantaneous velocity v = dx/dt. Here x = 0.2t³ − 2t² + 6t + 2 (m).

narration.en: Let us solve this together. x = 3t² + 2t (m). Find the velocity at t = 2 s.

say.en: Let us solve this together. x equals 3t squared plus 2t m. Find the velocity at t equals 2 seconds.
v equals dx over dt equals 6t plus 2.
At t equals 2 seconds: v equals 12 plus 2 equals 14 metres per second.
So the answer is 14 metres per second.

problem.en: For x = t³ − 6t² + 9t, when is the particle momentarily at rest?

steps.en: v = 0 at t = 1 s and t = 3 s.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. For x = t³ − 6t² + 9t, when is the particle momentarily at rest?

say.en: Let us solve this together. For x equals t cubed minus 6t squared plus 9t, when is the particle momentarily at rest?
v equals 3t squared minus 12t plus 9 equals 3t minus 1t minus 3.
v equals 0 at t equals 1 second and t equals 3 seconds.
So the answer is t equals 1 second and t equals 3 seconds.
